preconditions.description: The input is a single integer n representing the number of volumes and free places, where 1 ≤ n ≤ 100000.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.split()) == n and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: The output is a permutation of the integers from 1 to n, where each integer represents the volume number placed at a specific position.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= j <= n for j in range(1, n + 1)) and all(1 <= p(j) <= n for j in range(1, n + 1)) and len({p(j) for j in range(1, n + 1)}) == n
postconditions.description: The permutation p is a bijection from positions 1..n to volume numbers 1..n, meaning each volume appears exactly once in the permutation.

postconditions.expression: not any(i > 0 and any(j % i == 0 and p(j) % i == 0 for j in range(1, n + 1)) for i in range(1, n + 1)) or all(i > 0 and any(j % i == 0 and p(j) % i == 0 for j in range(1, n + 1)) for i in range(1, n + 1) if i in divisors)
postconditions.description: The permutation p minimizes the number of divisors i (1 ≤ i ≤ n) such that there exists at least one position j where both j and p(j) are divisible by i.

postconditions.expression: len({i for i in range(1, n + 1) if any(j % i == 0 and p(j) % i == 0 for j in range(1, n + 1))}) == min_count
postconditions.description: The number of divisors i (1 ≤ i ≤ n) for which there exists at least one position j where both j and p(j) are divisible by i is minimized, where min_count is the smallest possible such number across all valid permutations.
